lines.en: Sakaki-bar-a has been pretty busy as of late, but that never stops me from spending time with my favorite recovering addict.
lines.zh: Sakaki 酒吧最近相当繁忙,但这从来拦不住我和我最爱的、正在康复的瘾君子共度时光。

lines.en: It does, however, stop me from communicating with anyone else when I arrive tonight as both Sana and Sara are busy serving other customers.
lines.zh: 不过今晚我到店时,它确实拦住了我和其他任何人交谈——因为 Sana 和 Sara 都在招呼别的客人。

lines.en: After finishing up with one of her other tables, Yuki makes her way over to me and the two of us spend the next thirty minutes or so shooting the shit as she would call it.
lines.zh: Yuki 招呼完她那一桌,便朝我走来,接下来的三十来分钟,我们都在做她口中的「闲扯」。

lines.en: And what I've learned is that must mean “Listening to some early-thirties adult male complain about his problems.” Which, let's face it, is kind of what bars are for in the first place.
lines.zh: 而我学到的是,那一定意味着「听一个三十出头的成年男性抱怨他的人生」。老实讲,酒吧开着的初衷,本来就是这个。

lines.en: It feels like just the other day that that was all I could do in here, though. And I never imagined this place being even a fraction of as popular as it's become lately.
lines.zh: 不过感觉就在前几天,我在这里能做的也仅此而已。而我从未想过,这个地方会火到如今这步田地的哪怕零头。

lines.en: And weirdly enough, I think a lot of that is due to Yuki.
lines.zh: 而说来奇怪,我觉得其中很大一部分,要归功于 Yuki。

lines.en: She's the catalyst that helped turn this place around whether it makes sense or not.
lines.zh: 无论说不说得通,她都是帮这家店起死回生的催化剂。

lines.en: And sure, a lot of that could just be convenient timing. But when I'm talking to her, I can't help but think otherwise.
lines.zh: 当然,其中不少可能只是时机凑巧。但每当我和她聊天,我忍不住觉得并非如此。

lines.en: She's a surprisingly good listener. And even if her advice isn't always worded eloquently, it always seems to make sense.
lines.zh: 她是个出奇好的倾听者。即便她的建议措辞总是不够文雅,却总能讲得通。

lines.en: I don't need eloquence- just someone to be there.
lines.zh: 我不需要文雅——我只需要有人在。

lines.en: And tonight, that person is her.

lines.zh: Yuki 的好感度提升到了 [yuki_love]!
